paras: Marvell大漲5.8% 亮眼目標與AI敘事獲華爾街肯定

Google與美國最大核電反應爐持有業者Constellation Energy(CEG-US)達成20年核電購電協議，透過升級11座既有反應爐，新增890MW發電容量，規模約等同一座大型反應爐。這是核電業者與科技公司歷來最大的既有機組增容合作，帶動電力股周二(6日)盤中大漲。全文詳讀https://news.cnyes.com/news/id/6623239
AMD再創新高！花旗看好AI代理蓬勃發展下成大贏家

6億美元換五年授權！美光與Netlist專利戰達成和解

美光(MU-US)將支付6億美元，與記憶體技術公司Netlist(NLST-US)就記憶體晶片專利爭議達成和解，並取得涵蓋高頻寬記憶體(HBM)技術的專利組合授權，期限為五年。Netlist周二(6日)發布聲明表示，美光將每季支付3,000萬美元，五年合計6億美元。這項協議為雙方延續多年的專利爭端帶來進展，也涉及AI運算日益倚重的記憶體技術。全文詳讀https://news.cnyes.com/news/id/6623172
特斯拉Cybercab要來歐洲了！巴黎車展首度亮相但不開放搭乘
特斯拉(TSLA-US)將在10月12日揭幕的巴黎車展，首度於歐洲展示自駕計程車Cybercab。這款沒有方向盤與踏板的車型，是執行長馬斯克推動特斯拉轉型為AI產品公司的重要布局，不過本次展出不開放觀眾搭乘。全文詳讀https://news.cnyes.com/news/id/6623215
paras_en: Marvell jumps 5.8% bright target and AI narrative earn Wall Street approval

Marvell Technology (MRVL-US) has been one of the strongest performers in the S&P 500 this year, and the company’s latest signals suggest the strong growth could continue for several years. The stock surged 5.8% on Tuesday (the 6th) after the company announced a new long‑term revenue target, boosting investor confidence. Marvell projects revenue of about $80 billion for the fiscal year ending in January 2031. Full article: https://news.cnyes.com/news/id/6623285
AI power battle heats up! Google signs 20‑year nuclear power deal, utility stocks surge intraday

Google has reached a 20‑year nuclear power purchase agreement with Constellation Energy (CEG-US), the largest U.S. nuclear reactor owner. The deal upgrades 11 existing reactors, adding 890 MW of generation capacity—roughly the output of a large new reactor. It is the biggest capacity‑expansion partnership between a nuclear operator and a tech company, driving utility stocks higher on Tuesday (the 6th). Full article: https://news.cnyes.com/news/id/6623239
AMD hits new high! Citi bullish on AI agents becoming big winners

Advanced Micro Devices (AMD-US) shares kept climbing to a historic high as market optimism grows for chip demand driven by AI agents. Citi analysts on Tuesday (the 6th) lifted AMD’s price target from $575 to $800, the highest on Wall Street, citing expectations that AI agents will boost computing demand and, in turn, drive AMD chip sales. Full article: https://news.cnyes.com/news/id/6623313
$600 million for five‑year license! Micron settles patent fight with Netlist

Micron (MU-US) will pay $600 million to settle a memory‑chip patent dispute with Netlist (NLST-US) and obtain a five‑year license covering high‑bandwidth memory (HBM) technology. Netlist said on Tuesday (the 6th) that Micron will pay $30 million each quarter, totaling $600 million over five years. The agreement moves both parties forward in a long‑running litigation and involves memory technology increasingly critical for AI computing. Full article: https://news.cnyes.com/news/id/6623172
Tesla Cybercab coming to Europe! Debuts at Paris auto show but not open for rides

Tesla (TSLA-US) will unveil the autonomous taxi Cybercab at the Paris Motor Show on October 12, marking its first European display. The steering‑wheel‑ and pedal‑free vehicle is a key part of CEO Elon Musk’s plan to transform Tesla into an AI‑product company, but the exhibit will not allow visitors to ride in it. Full article: https://news.cnyes.com/news/id/6623215

items.title: 最快年底出貨！SK海力士旗下Solidigm增台灣ODM基地 擴大資料中心SSD供應
items.title_en: Fastest Year-End Shipment! SK Hynix's Solidigm Adds Taiwan ODM Base to Expand Data Center SSD Supply
paras: SK海力士旗下資料中心儲存子公司Solidigm9月25日發布產品變更通知(PCN)，宣布在台灣新增一家ODM製造基地，納入其資料中心SSD生產網絡，以提升製造彈性與營運持續性。
自2026年12月24日起，Solidigm客戶可能陸續收到新基地生產的產品，該公司也強調相關資料中心固態硬碟的型號、規格與品質不受影響。
韓媒《首爾經濟日報》此前報導，Solidigm已在台灣與力成科技、和碩聯合建立SSD ODM合作關係，新基地可視為既有產能的補充而非替代。在AI伺服器、高容量儲存需求持續放大下，分散生產據點有助降低單一廠區或物流中斷風險，並配合企業客戶對交期與合規的要求。
市場同時關注Solidigm資本動向。外媒先前披露，Solidigm正考慮最快2027年赴美IPO，估值最高上看1500億美元。
分析指出，Solidigm新增台灣ODM產能，可解讀為上市前鞏固供應鏈韌性、強化資料中心SSD出貨能力的布局。
法人認為，在HBM與AI帶動整體記憶體價值提升之際，Solidigm擴產與潛在IPO將進一步凸顯SK海力士在AI記憶體體系的綜合競爭力。
paras_en: Solidigm, the data center storage subsidiary of SK Hynix, issued a product change notice (PCN) on September 25 announcing the addition of a new ODM manufacturing base in Taiwan, integrating it into its data center SSD production network to improve manufacturing flexibility and operational continuity.

Starting December 24, 2026, Solidigm customers may begin receiving products manufactured at the new facility, and the company emphasizes that the models, specifications, and quality of the related data center solid-state drives will remain unchanged.

South Korean media outlet Seoul Economic Daily previously reported that Solidigm has established SSD ODM partnerships in Taiwan with Licheng Technology and Wistron, and the new base is viewed as a supplement to existing capacity rather than a replacement. With AI servers and high‑capacity storage demand continuing to grow, distributed production sites help reduce the risk of a single plant or logistics disruption and meet enterprise customers' requirements for delivery timelines and compliance.

The market is also watching Solidigm's capital moves. Foreign media have disclosed that Solidigm is considering an IPO in the United States as early as 2027, with a potential valuation of up to $150 billion.
Analysts note that the addition of Taiwan ODM capacity can be seen as a pre‑IPO strategy to strengthen supply‑chain resilience and boost data center SSD shipment capabilities.

Industry observers believe that, as HBM and AI drive overall memory value higher, Solidigm's expansion and potential IPO will further highlight SK Hynix's comprehensive competitiveness in the AI memory ecosystem.

items.title: 蘋果智慧家庭新品13日亮相 聯手LG開發門鈴、門鎖與恆溫器
items.title_en: Apple’s New Smart‑Home Products Debut on 13th, Partnering with LG to Develop Doorbells, Locks, and Thermostats
paras: 蘋果(AAPL-US) 即將擴大布局智慧家庭裝置，透過與樂金電子（LG Electronics）一項非典型合作，開發門鈴、恆溫器及其他配件。
彭博科技記者古爾曼指出，這些產品將納入蘋果的裝置生態系，搭配全新智慧家庭中樞、升級版HomePod mini及新版電視機上盒使用。蘋果這批新裝置預定於10月13日發表。
報導引述消息人士指出，與韓國LG共同開發的產品還包括智慧門鎖、室內與戶外監控攝影機，以及泛光燈攝影機。由於計畫尚未公開，這些人士要求匿名。

共同開發 掛LG品牌銷售

儘管配件由兩家公司共同開發，產品將以LG品牌銷售，並由LG負責製造及產品支援。
蘋果過去也曾採取類似策略，低調與鴻海(2317-TW) 旗下貝爾金（Belkin）、羅技（Logitech）等公司合作，開發以其他品牌銷售的產品。
這種與所謂「第二方供應商」合作的模式，讓蘋果能迅速擴大生態系，無須承擔生產及支援大量配件的全部成本與複雜流程。蘋果也能參與產品設計、調整功能及監督工程開發，同時讓多數合作內容維持保密。
LG配件的開發進度落後於蘋果自家裝置，預計至少還要幾個月才會上市。蘋果與LG發言人均不予置評。

認證文件揭露七款配件

近幾週，LG已向美國聯邦通訊委員會（FCC）及產品認證公司UL Solutions等機構申請核准。兩家機構的資料庫中，多份申請文件揭露了配件的產品名稱、規格、功能及圖面。
文件列出的產品包括LG有線視訊門鈴、泛光燈攝影機、插電式戶外攝影機、插電式室內攝影機、智慧門鎖、智慧恆溫器及溫度感測器。
LG要求將產品照片及更詳細資訊保密至明年初，文件並未提及蘋果參與開發。
多款裝置支援Wi-Fi及藍牙，也支援蘋果與競爭對手近年採用的Thread、Matter兩項智慧家庭通訊協定。智慧門鎖另具備超寬頻（UWB）功能，可在使用者接近家門時自動解鎖。

重啟HomeKit 搭配Siri AI助理

對蘋果而言，新的家庭生態系與裝置將象徵HomeKit正式重新出發。這個平台於2014年推出，但相較於亞馬遜及Alphabet旗下Google的產品，始終未能獲得廣泛採用。
蘋果希望透過智慧家庭裝置及Siri AI助理，為這項業務注入新動能。彭博先前報導，蘋果也規劃未來推出更多自家產品，包括強調隱私保護的居家監控裝置、螢幕連接機械手臂的智慧家庭中樞，以及居家安全監控服務。
對以電視及洗衣機聞名的LG而言，這批裝置也代表其智慧家庭業務進一步擴張。新產品涵蓋LG近十年來首款室內攝影機，以及近年來首款戶外攝影機、恆溫器、泛光燈攝影機與門鈴。LG也將首次在韓國以外市場銷售智慧門鎖。
這將使蘋果與LG更直接與亞馬遜(AMZN-US) Ring及Google(GOOGL-US) Nest競爭。後兩者已在智慧家庭市場站穩腳步，均提供類似裝置，讓使用者監看住宅及周邊環境的各個角落。

從螢幕到電視 雙方合作已久

蘋果與LG淵源深厚。兩家公司曾在智慧手機市場競爭，如今蘋果與LG電子旗下部分姊妹公司已是重要合作夥伴。LG Display為多款蘋果產品供應顯示面板，蘋果也曾與LG電子合作，將旗下服務整合至LG電視。
近十年前，蘋果一度退出外接電腦顯示器市場時，也曾與LG共同開發可搭配蘋果筆電使用的顯示器。
paras_en: Apple (AAPL‑US) is set to expand its smart‑home device lineup by partnering with LG Electronics in an atypical collaboration to develop doorbells, thermostats, and other accessories.

Bloomberg technology reporter Gurman noted that these products will be integrated into Apple’s device ecosystem, paired with a new smart‑home hub, an upgraded HomePod mini, and a new TV set‑top box. Apple’s new devices are scheduled to be announced on October 13.

Sources say that the products co‑developed with Korean LG also include smart door locks, indoor and outdoor surveillance cameras, and flood‑light cameras. Because the plan has not been made public, the sources requested anonymity.
Although the accessories are co‑developed by the two companies, the products will be sold under the LG brand and LG will handle manufacturing and product support.
Apple has previously used a similar strategy, quietly partnering with companies such as Belkin (under Foxconn, 2317‑TW) and Logitech to develop products sold under other brands.

This model of working with so‑called “second‑party suppliers” allows Apple to rapidly expand its ecosystem without bearing the full cost and complexity of producing and supporting large numbers of accessories. Apple can still participate in product design, tweak features, and oversee engineering development while keeping most collaboration details confidential.
LG accessory development is behind Apple’s own devices and is expected to take several more months before launch. Neither Apple nor LG spokespersons commented on the timeline.
Certification documents reveal seven accessories.

In recent weeks, LG has applied for approval from the U.S. Federal Communications Commission (FCC) and product certification company UL Solutions. Multiple application documents in the two agencies’ databases disclose the accessories’ product names, specifications, functions, and drawings.
The listed products include the LG wired video doorbell, flood‑light camera, plug‑in outdoor camera, plug‑in indoor camera, smart door lock, smart thermostat, and temperature sensor.

Multiple devices support Wi‑Fi and Bluetooth, and also support Apple’s and competitors’ recent Thread and Matter smart‑home communication protocols. The smart door lock also features ultra‑wideband (UWB) functionality, allowing it to unlock automatically when the user approaches the front door.

For Apple, the new home ecosystem and devices will symbolize a fresh start for HomeKit. The platform was launched in 2014 but has never achieved widespread adoption compared to Amazon and Alphabet’s Google products.

Apple hopes to inject new momentum into the business through smart‑home devices and the Siri AI assistant. Bloomberg previously reported that Apple also plans to launch more in‑house products in the future, including privacy‑focused home‑monitoring devices, a screen‑connected robotic arm smart‑home hub, and home‑security monitoring services.

For LG, known for TVs and washing machines, this batch of devices also represents further expansion of its smart‑home business. The new products cover LG’s first indoor camera in a decade, its first outdoor camera, thermostat, flood‑light camera, and doorbell. LG will also sell smart door locks for the first time outside Korea.

This will allow Apple and LG to compete more directly with Amazon (AMZN‑US) Ring and Google (GOOGL‑US) Nest. The latter two have already established a foothold in the smart‑home market, offering similar devices that let users monitor every corner of their homes and surroundings.

Apple and LG have a long history of collaboration. The two companies once competed in the smartphone market, but today Apple and some LG Electronics sister companies are important partners. LG Display supplies display panels for several Apple products, and Apple has also worked with LG Electronics to integrate its services into LG TVs.
A decade ago, when Apple briefly exited the external computer monitor market, it also co‑developed a monitor with LG that could be used with Apple laptops.

items.title: SpaceX股價自低點反彈50% 但這次漲勢與上市時不同
items.title_en: SpaceX Stock Bounces 50% From Low, Yet This Rally Differs From IPO Days
paras: SpaceX(SPCX-US) 股價再度起飛，但這次市場對後市波動的預期已有變化。
該股週一(5日)大漲8%，收在171美元，自低點反彈近50%，重回IPO發行價，週二0.49%。不過，選擇權隱含波動率已明顯低於上市初期，股價若想再創新高，可能需要更長時間。
隨著那斯達克100指數不斷刷新歷史新高，SpaceX再度成為市場焦點，也讓執行長馬斯克身家重新突破1兆美元。
摩根士丹利分析師喬納斯週一重申300美元目標價；上週四，獵鷹9號火箭以不到8小時將四名太空人送抵國際太空站，創下紀錄。
股價走強也帶動選擇權交易升溫。週一成交量達170萬口，為30日均量的兩倍，總價值9億美元，其中買權成交100萬口，價值超過6.4億美元。
這波熱度令人想起SpaceX於6月上市時的行情。當時股價在不到三個完整交易日內，便從171美元衝上225美元以上的盤中高點，隱含波動率超過110。
如今，經歷七週在10%價格區間內震盪後，該指標降至55，雖較上週四低於50的歷史低點回升，仍遠低於上市初期。
隱含波動率反映市場對未來股價波動幅度的預期。這意味著，除非SpaceX維持最近兩天的上漲速度，否則期待股價再創高點的交易員，可能得做好長期等待的準備。
依週一收盤的選擇權定價，造市商估算，SpaceX股價在明年7月前觸及225美元的機率不到50%；本月底前觸及185美元的機率則為54%。
Barchart數據顯示，SpaceX賣權的隱含波動率與買權相近，甚至更高，顯示市場也對大幅下跌風險有所戒備。相較之下，輝達多數到期合約的買權較貴，反映投資人更擔心錯過漲勢。
不過，週一選擇權資金流向仍偏樂觀。芝加哥選擇權交易所LiveVol數據顯示，交易員可能買進45.6萬口買權，買進賣權則不到24萬口。
普羅斯珀交易學院交易員穆恩表示，星艦計畫提供助力，華爾街似乎自第四季開始積極進場，SpaceX與特斯拉近期走勢也愈來愈同步。
喬納斯則認為，考量成長因素，SpaceX是布局太空與情報經濟潛在商機時，估值相對低廉的標的之一。
paras_en: SpaceX (SPCX-US) stock is taking off again, but this time the market’s expectations for future volatility have shifted.

The shares surged 8% on Monday (the 5th), closing at $171, rebounding nearly 50% from their lows and returning to the IPO price, up 0.49% on Tuesday. However, implied volatility in the options is already markedly lower than in the early trading days, meaning a new high may take longer to achieve.
As the Nasdaq‑100 continues to set fresh all‑time highs, SpaceX is once again in the spotlight, pushing CEO Elon Musk’s net worth back above the $1 trillion mark.

Morgan Stanley analyst Jonas reiterated a $300 target price on Monday; last Thursday, the Falcon 9 rocket delivered four astronauts to the International Space Station in under eight hours, setting a new record.

The stock’s strength also heated up options trading. Monday’s volume hit 1.7 million contracts, double the 30‑day average, with a total value of $900 million, including 1 million call contracts worth over $640 million.

The buzz recalls SpaceX’s market action when it listed in June. Back then, the price jumped from $171 to intraday highs above $225 in less than three full trading days, with implied volatility exceeding 110%.
Now, after seven weeks of trading within a 10% price band, that metric has fallen to 55, still well below the early‑listing levels even though it rose from the sub‑50 low seen last Thursday.

Implied volatility reflects the market’s view of future price swings. This means that unless SpaceX maintains the recent two‑day rally pace, traders betting on another high will need to be prepared for a longer wait.

Based on Monday’s closing options prices, market makers estimate less than a 50% chance that SpaceX will reach $225 before July next year, while the probability of hitting $185 by the end of the month stands at 54%.

Barchart data shows SpaceX’s put implied volatility is similar to, or even higher than, calls, indicating the market is also wary of a sharp downside. By contrast, most of Nvidia’s near‑term call contracts are pricier, reflecting investors’ greater fear of missing upside.
Nevertheless, Monday’s options flow remained optimistic. Chicago Board Options Exchange LiveVol data suggests traders may have bought 456,000 call contracts versus fewer than 240,000 put contracts.

Prosper Trading Academy trader Moon said the Starship program provides a boost, Wall Street appears to have been actively buying since Q4, and SpaceX’s recent moves are increasingly mirroring Tesla’s.
Jonas added that, given growth prospects, SpaceX is one of the relatively cheap stocks to consider when positioning for potential opportunities in the space and intelligence economies.

items.title: AMD再創新高！花旗看好AI代理蓬勃發展下成大贏家
items.title_en: AMD Hits New High Again! Citi Sees It as a Big Winner Amid Booming AI Agents
paras: 《Investopedia》報導，超微(Advanced Micro Devices, AMD)(AMD-US)股價持續上漲並創下歷史新高，市場對AI代理帶動的晶片需求日益樂觀。
花旗(Citi)分析師周二(6日)將AMD目標價從575美元大幅上調至華爾街最高的800美元，理由是預期AI代理將推升運算需求，進而帶動超微晶片的需求。
AMD股價周二盤中一度突破658美元，再創盤中新高，終場收漲2.8%，報每股649.42美元，改寫收盤新高。
花旗分析師指出，隨著Meta(META-US)的Muse與OpenAI的Dots等AI代理日益普及，他們目前預估CPU市場規模將從去年的250億美元，大幅擴張至2030年的3,000億美元。
分析師認為，這對AMD而言是一大利多，並告訴客戶，他們將AMD視為「CPU復興的關鍵受益者」。
AMD執行長蘇姿丰周二在台灣接受媒體採訪時表示，公司計劃在明年「大幅增加」供應能力，以因應「非常高的需求」。
華爾街分析師普遍看多AMD。在Visible Alpha追蹤的另外11名分析師中，除了1人之外，其餘分析師都建議買進AMD股票，另有1人給予中立評級。他們的平均目標價約為678美元。
隨著周二股價持續上漲，AMD今年以來股價漲幅已超過3倍。
paras_en: Investopedia reports that Advanced Micro Devices (AMD) stock continues to rise and hits an all‑time high, with the market becoming increasingly optimistic about chip demand driven by AI agents.
Citi analysts on Tuesday (the 6th) lifted AMD’s price target from $575 to a Wall Street‑high $800, citing expectations that AI agents will boost computing demand and thus drive demand for AMD chips.
AMD’s share price on Tuesday intraday briefly broke $658, setting a new intra‑day high, and closed up 2.8% at $649.42, establishing a new closing high.

Citi analysts note that as AI agents such as Meta’s Muse and OpenAI’s Dots become more widespread, they now estimate the CPU market size will expand from $25 billion last year to $300 billion by 2030.
The analysts say this is a major tailwind for AMD and tell clients they view AMD as the “key beneficiary of a CPU resurgence.”
AMD CEO Lisa Su (苏姿丰) said in a media interview in Taiwan on Tuesday that the company plans to “significantly increase” capacity next year to meet “very high demand.”

Wall Street analysts are broadly bullish on AMD. Among the 11 other analysts tracked by Visible Alpha, all but one recommend buying AMD stock, with one giving a neutral rating. Their average price target is about $678.
With Tuesday’s continued price rise, AMD’s stock has more than tripled so far this year.

英國《金融時報》報導，相關人士表示，Apollo Global Management料將牽頭這筆交易，並協助向廣泛投資者出售SpaceX債券。

It is understood that bond firm PIMCO is one of a small group of lenders currently negotiating to provide financing for the deal, which is slated to be completed in 2027.

items.title: 財報季將至 AI晶片熱潮延續？高盛押注3檔「驚喜股」另3檔恐令人失望
items.title_en: Earnings Season Approaches: Will the AI Chip Boom Continue? Goldman Sachs Bets on Three “Surprise” Stocks While Three Others May Disappoint
paras: 近年來晶片股持續成為美股市場的重要主流板塊, 隨著第三季財報季即將展開, 高盛認為半導體產業本輪漲勢仍有望延續, 但不同企業的基本面與市場預期已出現明顯差異。
高盛分析師詹姆斯・施奈德(James Schneider)及其團隊看好應用材料(Applied Materials)、楷登電子(Cadence Design Systems)及微芯科技(Microchip Technology), 均給予「買入」評級; 相較之下, 高通(Qualcomm)、科磊(KLA)及西部資料(Western Digital)則被評為「中性」。
高盛認為, 應用材料(AMAT-US)可能在接下來的產業活動及財報中帶來正面驚喜。儘管該股今年迄今已上漲逾一倍, 大幅上漲使公司要進一步超越市場預期的難度提高, 但施奈德仍預期公司很快可能釋放更多利多訊號。
施奈德在周一發布的研究報告中指出, 高盛預期應用材料將在10月舉行的西部半導體展(SEMICON West)上調整利潤率目標, 並提出強勁的成長展望, 後續公布的財報也可望交出亮眼成績。
SEMICON West是半導體產業的重要年度活動, 今年將於10月13日至15日在舊金山舉行。根據官方資訊, 應用材料預計在11月12日公布第四財季財報。市場將關注公司對半導體設備需求、先進製程投資及未來利潤率的最新看法。
高盛另一項看好的標的是楷登電子(CDNS-US)。分析師認為, 該公司受惠於多項客製化晶片專案, 可能進一步上修全年營收展望。目前公司原先預期今年營收成長約18%, 高盛預估該數字可能被上調至約21%。
隨著人工智慧運算需求持續推動資料中心投資, 客製化晶片的重要性也逐步提高。楷登電子提供電子設計自動化(EDA)軟體及相關設計工具, 因此可望從大型科技企業與晶片設計商持續投入AI及客製化加速器的趨勢中受惠。
高盛同時看好類比晶片製造商微芯科技(MCHP-US), 預期資料中心以及航太與國防領域需求強勁, 將推動公司營運改善。高盛團隊預估, 微芯科技毛利率可能回升至約66%, 若實際表現優於市場預期, 將有助於改善投資人對公司獲利能力的看法。
不過, 高盛認為並非所有半導體企業都能在本次財報季延續漲勢。高通(QCOM-US)、科磊(KLAC-US)及西部資料(WDC-US)目前均獲得「中性」評級, 主要原因包括市場預期偏高、成長指引相對保守以及競爭壓力等因素。
高通近期股價受到提振, 原因是公司上月宣布與亞馬遜(Amazon-AMZN-US)達成晶片合作協議。這項合作強化市場對高通進軍資料中心市場的期待, 但高盛認為, 相關利多可能已推升投資人預期至偏高水準。
施奈德表示, 高盛認為短期內市場對高通的期待可能過高, 投資人目前正試圖量化高通資料中心業務最初能帶來多少營收, 同時也希望進一步確認智慧型手機市場是否有復甦可能。
高通目前正積極降低對智慧型手機市場的依賴, 並尋求透過資料中心、汽車及物聯網等領域擴大營收來源。因此, 本次財報除了傳統手機晶片業務的表現之外, 市場也將密切關注資料中心相關業務的實際進展。
科磊(KLAC-US)則面臨另一項問題。雖然全球半導體產業持續增加晶圓製造設備支出, 高盛認為科磊對未來成長的目標似乎相對保守。公司目前給出的2026及2027年營收成長指引約為25%, 市場將評估實際需求是否有機會超越這項預期。
科磊主要提供半導體製程控制與檢測設備, 因此可直接受惠於先進製程及晶圓廠資本支出增加。然而, 若公司自身指引低於市場對AI晶片及先進製程投資的期待, 股價仍可能受到壓力。
西部資料(WDC-US)則可能面臨來自競爭對手希捷科技(Seagate Technology-STX-US)的壓力。高盛指出, 希捷在熱輔助磁記錄(HAMR)技術上的推進速度較快, 這項技術能夠提高傳統機械硬碟的儲存密度及容量, 若技術商業化進度持續領先, 希捷可能進一步搶占市場份額。
HAMR是硬碟產業提升儲存容量的重要技術之一, 透過在寫入資料時利用熱能降低磁性材料的寫入難度, 讓單位面積可以儲存更多資料。隨著人工智慧及雲端運算帶動資料中心儲存需求增加, 大型資料中心業者對高容量硬碟的需求也持續增加, 使HAMR技術成為硬碟產業競爭的關鍵。
對投資人而言, 今年半導體及相關硬體股的強勁漲勢也意味著財報季的市場門檻已明顯提高。企業即使公布正面的營運數據, 若未能超越市場預期或上修全年展望, 股價仍可能因「利多不漲」而承壓。
高盛目前的選股邏輯主要集中在企業能否進一步提高獲利預期。應用材料的關鍵在於利潤率及成長展望, 楷登電子受惠於客製化晶片需求而有機會上修營收預測, 微芯科技則期待毛利率改善; 相對之下, 高通面臨預期過高的問題, 科磊的成長指引偏保守, 西部資料則需要面對希捷HAMR技術進展帶來的競爭威脅。
隨著10月財報季正式展開, 半導體企業的訂單、資本支出、AI需求、資料中心投資及2027年展望將成為市場評估股價能否延續漲勢的重要依據。高盛的最新評估顯示, 在晶片產業整體仍處於強勢週期的情況下, 投資人真正需要關注的已不只是產業是否成長, 而是企業實際表現能否超越已被推高的市場預期。
paras_en: In recent years semiconductor stocks have become a core mainstream sector of the U.S. market. With the third‑quarter earnings season about to begin, Goldman Sachs believes the current rally in the semiconductor industry can still continue, but the fundamentals and market expectations for different companies have begun to diverge sharply.

Goldman analysts James Schneider and his team are bullish on Applied Materials, Cadence Design Systems and Microchip Technology, giving each a “Buy” rating; by contrast Qualcomm, KLA and Western Digital are rated “Neutral.”

Goldman sees Applied Materials (AMAT‑US) potentially delivering a pleasant surprise in upcoming industry activity and earnings. Although the stock has already more than doubled this year, the steep rise makes it harder for the company to exceed market expectations, yet Schneider still expects the firm may soon release additional positive signals.

In a research report released on Monday, Schneider noted that Goldman expects Applied Materials to adjust its margin target at the SEMICON West show in October and to present a strong growth outlook, with the subsequent earnings report likely to be impressive.

SEMICON West is a key annual event for the semiconductor industry, scheduled for Oct. 13‑15 in San Francisco. According to official information, Applied Materials plans to release its Q4 earnings on Nov. 12. The market will watch the company’s latest views on semiconductor equipment demand, advanced‑process investment and future margins.

Another stock Goldman likes is Cadence Design Systems (CDNS‑US). Analysts believe the company, benefitting from multiple custom‑chip projects, could raise its full‑year revenue outlook. Cadence originally projected about 18% revenue growth this year; Goldman estimates that figure could be lifted to roughly 21%.

As AI compute demand continues to drive data‑center investment, the importance of custom chips is growing. Cadence provides electronic design automation (EDA) software and related tools, positioning it to benefit from the ongoing AI and custom‑accelerator spending by large tech firms and chip designers.

Goldman also favors analog‑chip maker Microchip Technology (MCHP‑US), expecting strong demand from data centers as well as aerospace and defense sectors to drive operational improvement. The team projects Microchip’s gross margin could rebound to around 66%; if actual performance exceeds market expectations, it would improve investors’ view of the company’s profitability.

However, Goldman cautions that not all semiconductor firms can sustain the rally this earnings season. Qualcomm (QCOM‑US), KLA (KLAC‑US) and Western Digital (WDC‑US) all carry “Neutral” ratings, mainly because of lofty market expectations, relatively conservative growth guidance and competitive pressures.

Qualcomm’s recent share rise was sparked by the company’s announcement last month of a chip partnership with Amazon (AMZN‑US). The deal has heightened expectations for Qualcomm’s push into the data‑center market, but Goldman believes the related upside may have already pushed investor expectations to overly high levels.

Schneider said Goldman thinks market expectations for Qualcomm may be too high in the short term, as investors try to quantify how much revenue the nascent data‑center business can initially generate while also seeking confirmation of a possible smartphone market recovery.

Qualcomm is actively reducing its reliance on the smartphone market and is looking to expand revenue through data‑center, automotive and IoT segments. Therefore, beyond the traditional handset‑chip performance, the market will closely monitor the actual progress of its data‑center business in the upcoming earnings.

KLA (KLAC‑US) faces a different issue. Although global semiconductor capital spending on wafer‑fab equipment continues to rise, Goldman feels KLA’s growth targets appear relatively modest. The company’s 2026‑2027 revenue growth guidance is about 25%, and the market will assess whether actual demand could exceed that outlook.

KLA primarily supplies semiconductor process‑control and inspection equipment, so it stands to benefit directly from advanced‑process and fab‑capex growth. However, if its guidance falls short of market expectations for AI chips and advanced‑process investment, the stock could remain under pressure.

Western Digital (WDC‑US) may face pressure from rival Seagate Technology (STX‑US). Goldman points out that Seagate is advancing its heat‑assisted magnetic recording (HAMR) technology faster, a technique that can boost storage density and capacity of traditional mechanical hard drives. If commercialisation stays ahead, Seagate could capture additional market share.

HAMR is one of the key technologies for increasing hard‑drive capacity, using heat to lower the magnetic coercivity during writes so more data can be stored per unit area. As AI and cloud computing drive higher data‑center storage needs, large‑scale data‑center operators are seeking higher‑capacity drives, making HAMR a critical competitive factor in the HDD industry.

For investors, the strong rally in semiconductor and related hardware stocks this year means the earnings‑season market bar has risen sharply. Even if companies post positive operating numbers, failing to beat expectations or raise full‑year outlooks can still weigh on the stock due to “good news that doesn’t move the price.”

Goldman’s current stock‑selection logic focuses on whether companies can further lift profit expectations. Applied Materials hinges on margin and growth outlook, Cadence benefits from custom‑chip demand that could raise revenue forecasts, and Microchip looks for margin improvement; in contrast, Qualcomm faces overly high expectations, KLA’s guidance is conservative, and Western Digital must contend with Seagate’s HAMR progress.

As the October earnings season officially kicks off, order flow, capex, AI demand, data‑center investment and 2027 outlooks for semiconductor firms will be key metrics for assessing whether stock prices can keep rising. Goldman’s latest assessment shows that, with the chip industry still in a strong cycle, investors need to focus not just on industry growth but on whether individual companies can surpass the elevated market expectations.

items.title: 最快年底出貨！SK海力士旗下Solidigm增台灣ODM基地 擴大資料中心SSD供應
items.title_en: Fastest Year-End Shipment! SK Hynix's Solidigm Adds Taiwan ODM Base to Expand Data Center SSD Supply
paras: SK海力士旗下資料中心儲存子公司Solidigm9月25日發布產品變更通知(PCN)，宣布在台灣新增一家ODM製造基地，納入其資料中心SSD生產網絡，以提升製造彈性與營運持續性。
自2026年12月24日起，Solidigm客戶可能陸續收到新基地生產的產品，該公司也強調相關資料中心固態硬碟的型號、規格與品質不受影響。
韓媒《首爾經濟日報》此前報導，Solidigm已在台灣與力成科技、和碩聯合建立SSD ODM合作關係，新基地可視為既有產能的補充而非替代。在AI伺服器、高容量儲存需求持續放大下，分散生產據點有助降低單一廠區或物流中斷風險，並配合企業客戶對交期與合規的要求。
市場同時關注Solidigm資本動向。外媒先前披露，Solidigm正考慮最快2027年赴美IPO，估值最高上看1500億美元。
分析指出，Solidigm新增台灣ODM產能，可解讀為上市前鞏固供應鏈韌性、強化資料中心SSD出貨能力的布局。
法人認為，在HBM與AI帶動整體記憶體價值提升之際，Solidigm擴產與潛在IPO將進一步凸顯SK海力士在AI記憶體體系的綜合競爭力。
paras_en: Solidigm, the data center storage subsidiary of SK Hynix, issued a product change notice (PCN) on September 25 announcing the addition of a new ODM manufacturing base in Taiwan, integrating it into its data center SSD production network to improve manufacturing flexibility and operational continuity.

Starting December 24, 2026, Solidigm customers may begin receiving products manufactured at the new facility, and the company emphasizes that the models, specifications, and quality of the related data center solid-state drives will remain unchanged.

South Korean media outlet Seoul Economic Daily previously reported that Solidigm has established SSD ODM partnerships in Taiwan with Licheng Technology and Wistron, and the new base is viewed as a supplement to existing capacity rather than a replacement. With AI servers and high‑capacity storage demand continuing to grow, distributed production sites help reduce the risk of a single plant or logistics disruption and meet enterprise customers' requirements for delivery timelines and compliance.

The market is also watching Solidigm's capital moves. Foreign media have disclosed that Solidigm is considering an IPO in the United States as early as 2027, with a potential valuation of up to $150 billion.
Analysts note that the addition of Taiwan ODM capacity can be seen as a pre‑IPO strategy to strengthen supply‑chain resilience and boost data center SSD shipment capabilities.

Industry observers believe that, as HBM and AI drive overall memory value higher, Solidigm's expansion and potential IPO will further highlight SK Hynix's comprehensive competitiveness in the AI memory ecosystem.

items.title: TIS揭露上限引論戰！保險局捍衛三大監理原則 「承諾跳票」標示最快明年4月底現形
items.title_en: TIS Disclosure Upper Limit Sparks Debate! Insurance Bureau Defends Three Core Supervisory Principles, “Commitment Default” Star Mark to Appear by End of April 2027
paras: 富邦金控(2881-TW)董事長昨(5)日公開透露富邦人壽真實 TIS(資本適足率)177%，市場關注是否打破金管會的揭露規定。保險局副局長蔡火炎今(6)日與媒體唇槍舌戰，強調監理上限是為維持市場穩定與公平性，不希望私下揭露、排名造成混淆，業者若自認體質健全亦可申請提早終止過渡。此外，保險局也證實，檢驗業者資本改善承諾的兩顆星「**」標示，最快將於明(2027)年4月現形，藉此評估業者有無說到做到。
我國保險業接軌新一代清償能力制度，金管會提供業者15年的選擇性過渡措施，依現行規範，有申請過渡的壽險公司，即便上半年因獲利良好、自行算出過渡後的 TIS 比率高於當初向保險局申報的目標值，公開資訊揭露時仍必須以「目標資本適足率」為上限，如140%，並在右上角加註「*」號標示。
媒體質疑，富邦人壽若因本身投資與獲利能力優異而算出TIS 177%，保險局卻強制要求蓋上「140%上限」的帽子，導致市場與外資分析師無法辨識誰才是真正財務體質健全的公司，「資訊揭露初衷不就是讓好的被看到、差的去改善嗎？」媒體直批，資本適足率與淨值比長年以來是保戶、投資人評估保險公司財務風險最重要的指標，如今蓋上保護傘後，外界完全失去比較基準。
對此，蔡火炎提出三大核心監理立場，首先，過渡措施的分子與分母均有納入監理給予的資本調整數(借來的額度)，因此，過渡後的計算數值並不能反映完全的經濟實質。為避免15年過渡期間公司的TIS比率隨市場劇烈波動、影響金融穩定，金管會訂定「揭露以目標值為上限」是既定監理架構，並非臨時變更。
對於富邦人壽揭露的TIS 177% 與提前結束過渡期，蔡火炎明確表態，金管會允許業者申請提早終止選擇性過渡措施。一旦終止，公司未來數值「是多少就寫多少」，不再受上限限制。他也警示，「一旦申請提早終止，未來若財務狀況不如預期，絕不可能再回頭申請適用過渡措施。」
其次，蔡火炎強調，資本適足率是保險局對公司的資本監理工具，本就不適合拿來做公司間的排名比較，更不能當作業務員在市場上招攬保單、打壓同業的競爭工具。他建議保戶與投資人應綜合參考財報、EPS、淨值比及保單繼續率等 20 多項財業務公開資訊。
第三則是針對承諾跳票的公司，「**」懲罰性的標示何時出現？蔡火炎表示，保險局將在今年底檢驗各大壽險公司「說到有沒有做到」，若業者今年度未達成資本改善規劃目標，最快在2027年4月底公布今年底TIS比率時，就會首度出現「兩顆星」的懲罰性標示。
paras_en: Fubon Financial Holding (2881‑TW) chairman publicly disclosed yesterday (May 5) that Fubon Life’s actual TIS (capital adequacy ratio) stands at 177%, prompting market speculation about a possible breach of the Financial Supervisory Commission’s disclosure rules. Insurance Bureau Deputy Director Cai Huoyan engaged in a sharp exchange with the media today (May 6), stressing that the supervisory ceiling is intended to preserve market stability and fairness and that private disclosures or rankings could cause confusion. Companies that consider themselves financially sound may also apply to terminate the transitional period early. The bureau also confirmed that the two‑star “**” penalty label for firms that fail to meet capital‑improvement commitments could appear as early as April 2027, allowing regulators to assess whether firms follow through on their promises.

Taiwan’s insurance sector is aligning with a new generation solvency framework, with the Financial Supervisory Commission offering a 15‑year optional transition. Under current rules, life insurers that have applied for the transition must, even if strong first‑half earnings yield a post‑transition TIS higher than the target originally reported to the bureau, disclose only the “target capital adequacy ratio” as the ceiling—e.g., 140%—and mark it with an asterisk in the upper‑right corner.

The media questioned why, if Fubon Life’s own calculations show a TIS of 177% thanks to superior investment and profit performance, the bureau would force a “140% ceiling” label, preventing the market and foreign analysts from identifying the truly financially sound companies. They argued that the purpose of disclosure is to highlight the strong and push the weak to improve, and that capital adequacy and net‑worth ratios have long been the key metrics for policyholders and investors to assess insurers’ financial risk. With a protective cap now in place, the external benchmark disappears.

In response, Cai Huoyan outlined three core supervisory positions. First, both the numerator and denominator in the transition calculations incorporate capital adjustments granted by regulators (borrowed capacity), so the post‑transition figures do not fully reflect economic reality. To prevent a company’s TIS from wildly fluctuating during the 15‑year transition and threatening financial stability, the FSC set the “disclosure limited to the target value” rule as a fixed supervisory framework, not a temporary change.

Regarding Fubon Life’s disclosed 177% TIS and its request to end the transition early, Cai stated that the FSC permits firms to apply for early termination of the optional transition. Once terminated, the company may report whatever figure it actually has, without any ceiling. He warned that if a firm applies for early termination and later its financial condition falls short of expectations, it cannot revert to the transition regime.

Second, Cai emphasized that the capital adequacy ratio is a supervisory tool of the Insurance Bureau, not a metric for inter‑company ranking or a marketing weapon for agents to attract policies or pressure competitors. He advised policyholders and investors to consider a comprehensive set of more than 20 disclosed financial and operational indicators, such as financial statements, EPS, net‑worth ratios, and policy persistency rates.

Third, concerning firms that miss their improvement commitments, Cai explained that the punitive “**” star label will appear when. The bureau will assess at year‑end whether each major life insurer has fulfilled its capital‑improvement plan. If a company fails to meet its target this year, the two‑star penalty could be applied as early as the end of April 2027 when the year‑end TIS is published.

items.title: 蘋果智慧家庭新品13日亮相 聯手LG開發門鈴、門鎖與恆溫器
items.title_en: Apple’s New Smart‑Home Products Debut on 13th, Partnering with LG to Develop Doorbells, Locks, and Thermostats
paras: 蘋果(AAPL-US) 即將擴大布局智慧家庭裝置，透過與樂金電子（LG Electronics）一項非典型合作，開發門鈴、恆溫器及其他配件。
彭博科技記者古爾曼指出，這些產品將納入蘋果的裝置生態系，搭配全新智慧家庭中樞、升級版HomePod mini及新版電視機上盒使用。蘋果這批新裝置預定於10月13日發表。
報導引述消息人士指出，與韓國LG共同開發的產品還包括智慧門鎖、室內與戶外監控攝影機，以及泛光燈攝影機。由於計畫尚未公開，這些人士要求匿名。

共同開發 掛LG品牌銷售

儘管配件由兩家公司共同開發，產品將以LG品牌銷售，並由LG負責製造及產品支援。
蘋果過去也曾採取類似策略，低調與鴻海(2317-TW) 旗下貝爾金（Belkin）、羅技（Logitech）等公司合作，開發以其他品牌銷售的產品。
這種與所謂「第二方供應商」合作的模式，讓蘋果能迅速擴大生態系，無須承擔生產及支援大量配件的全部成本與複雜流程。蘋果也能參與產品設計、調整功能及監督工程開發，同時讓多數合作內容維持保密。
LG配件的開發進度落後於蘋果自家裝置，預計至少還要幾個月才會上市。蘋果與LG發言人均不予置評。

認證文件揭露七款配件

近幾週，LG已向美國聯邦通訊委員會（FCC）及產品認證公司UL Solutions等機構申請核准。兩家機構的資料庫中，多份申請文件揭露了配件的產品名稱、規格、功能及圖面。
文件列出的產品包括LG有線視訊門鈴、泛光燈攝影機、插電式戶外攝影機、插電式室內攝影機、智慧門鎖、智慧恆溫器及溫度感測器。
LG要求將產品照片及更詳細資訊保密至明年初，文件並未提及蘋果參與開發。
多款裝置支援Wi-Fi及藍牙，也支援蘋果與競爭對手近年採用的Thread、Matter兩項智慧家庭通訊協定。智慧門鎖另具備超寬頻（UWB）功能，可在使用者接近家門時自動解鎖。

重啟HomeKit 搭配Siri AI助理

對蘋果而言，新的家庭生態系與裝置將象徵HomeKit正式重新出發。這個平台於2014年推出，但相較於亞馬遜及Alphabet旗下Google的產品，始終未能獲得廣泛採用。
蘋果希望透過智慧家庭裝置及Siri AI助理，為這項業務注入新動能。彭博先前報導，蘋果也規劃未來推出更多自家產品，包括強調隱私保護的居家監控裝置、螢幕連接機械手臂的智慧家庭中樞，以及居家安全監控服務。
對以電視及洗衣機聞名的LG而言，這批裝置也代表其智慧家庭業務進一步擴張。新產品涵蓋LG近十年來首款室內攝影機，以及近年來首款戶外攝影機、恆溫器、泛光燈攝影機與門鈴。LG也將首次在韓國以外市場銷售智慧門鎖。
這將使蘋果與LG更直接與亞馬遜(AMZN-US) Ring及Google(GOOGL-US) Nest競爭。後兩者已在智慧家庭市場站穩腳步，均提供類似裝置，讓使用者監看住宅及周邊環境的各個角落。

從螢幕到電視 雙方合作已久

蘋果與LG淵源深厚。兩家公司曾在智慧手機市場競爭，如今蘋果與LG電子旗下部分姊妹公司已是重要合作夥伴。LG Display為多款蘋果產品供應顯示面板，蘋果也曾與LG電子合作，將旗下服務整合至LG電視。
近十年前，蘋果一度退出外接電腦顯示器市場時，也曾與LG共同開發可搭配蘋果筆電使用的顯示器。
paras_en: Apple (AAPL‑US) is set to expand its smart‑home device lineup by partnering with LG Electronics in an atypical collaboration to develop doorbells, thermostats, and other accessories.

Bloomberg technology reporter Gurman noted that these products will be integrated into Apple’s device ecosystem, paired with a new smart‑home hub, an upgraded HomePod mini, and a new TV set‑top box. Apple’s new devices are scheduled to be announced on October 13.

Sources say that the products co‑developed with Korean LG also include smart door locks, indoor and outdoor surveillance cameras, and flood‑light cameras. Because the plan has not been made public, the sources requested anonymity.
Although the accessories are co‑developed by the two companies, the products will be sold under the LG brand and LG will handle manufacturing and product support.
Apple has previously used a similar strategy, quietly partnering with companies such as Belkin (under Foxconn, 2317‑TW) and Logitech to develop products sold under other brands.

This model of working with so‑called “second‑party suppliers” allows Apple to rapidly expand its ecosystem without bearing the full cost and complexity of producing and supporting large numbers of accessories. Apple can still participate in product design, tweak features, and oversee engineering development while keeping most collaboration details confidential.
LG accessory development is behind Apple’s own devices and is expected to take several more months before launch. Neither Apple nor LG spokespersons commented on the timeline.
Certification documents reveal seven accessories.

In recent weeks, LG has applied for approval from the U.S. Federal Communications Commission (FCC) and product certification company UL Solutions. Multiple application documents in the two agencies’ databases disclose the accessories’ product names, specifications, functions, and drawings.
The listed products include the LG wired video doorbell, flood‑light camera, plug‑in outdoor camera, plug‑in indoor camera, smart door lock, smart thermostat, and temperature sensor.

Multiple devices support Wi‑Fi and Bluetooth, and also support Apple’s and competitors’ recent Thread and Matter smart‑home communication protocols. The smart door lock also features ultra‑wideband (UWB) functionality, allowing it to unlock automatically when the user approaches the front door.

For Apple, the new home ecosystem and devices will symbolize a fresh start for HomeKit. The platform was launched in 2014 but has never achieved widespread adoption compared to Amazon and Alphabet’s Google products.

Apple hopes to inject new momentum into the business through smart‑home devices and the Siri AI assistant. Bloomberg previously reported that Apple also plans to launch more in‑house products in the future, including privacy‑focused home‑monitoring devices, a screen‑connected robotic arm smart‑home hub, and home‑security monitoring services.

For LG, known for TVs and washing machines, this batch of devices also represents further expansion of its smart‑home business. The new products cover LG’s first indoor camera in a decade, its first outdoor camera, thermostat, flood‑light camera, and doorbell. LG will also sell smart door locks for the first time outside Korea.

This will allow Apple and LG to compete more directly with Amazon (AMZN‑US) Ring and Google (GOOGL‑US) Nest. The latter two have already established a foothold in the smart‑home market, offering similar devices that let users monitor every corner of their homes and surroundings.

Apple and LG have a long history of collaboration. The two companies once competed in the smartphone market, but today Apple and some LG Electronics sister companies are important partners. LG Display supplies display panels for several Apple products, and Apple has also worked with LG Electronics to integrate its services into LG TVs.
A decade ago, when Apple briefly exited the external computer monitor market, it also co‑developed a monitor with LG that could be used with Apple laptops.

items.title: SpaceX股價自低點反彈50% 但這次漲勢與上市時不同
items.title_en: SpaceX Stock Bounces 50% From Low, Yet This Rally Differs From IPO Days
paras: SpaceX(SPCX-US) 股價再度起飛，但這次市場對後市波動的預期已有變化。
該股週一(5日)大漲8%，收在171美元，自低點反彈近50%，重回IPO發行價，週二0.49%。不過，選擇權隱含波動率已明顯低於上市初期，股價若想再創新高，可能需要更長時間。
隨著那斯達克100指數不斷刷新歷史新高，SpaceX再度成為市場焦點，也讓執行長馬斯克身家重新突破1兆美元。
摩根士丹利分析師喬納斯週一重申300美元目標價；上週四，獵鷹9號火箭以不到8小時將四名太空人送抵國際太空站，創下紀錄。
股價走強也帶動選擇權交易升溫。週一成交量達170萬口，為30日均量的兩倍，總價值9億美元，其中買權成交100萬口，價值超過6.4億美元。
這波熱度令人想起SpaceX於6月上市時的行情。當時股價在不到三個完整交易日內，便從171美元衝上225美元以上的盤中高點，隱含波動率超過110。
如今，經歷七週在10%價格區間內震盪後，該指標降至55，雖較上週四低於50的歷史低點回升，仍遠低於上市初期。
隱含波動率反映市場對未來股價波動幅度的預期。這意味著，除非SpaceX維持最近兩天的上漲速度，否則期待股價再創高點的交易員，可能得做好長期等待的準備。
依週一收盤的選擇權定價，造市商估算，SpaceX股價在明年7月前觸及225美元的機率不到50%；本月底前觸及185美元的機率則為54%。
Barchart數據顯示，SpaceX賣權的隱含波動率與買權相近，甚至更高，顯示市場也對大幅下跌風險有所戒備。相較之下，輝達多數到期合約的買權較貴，反映投資人更擔心錯過漲勢。
不過，週一選擇權資金流向仍偏樂觀。芝加哥選擇權交易所LiveVol數據顯示，交易員可能買進45.6萬口買權，買進賣權則不到24萬口。
普羅斯珀交易學院交易員穆恩表示，星艦計畫提供助力，華爾街似乎自第四季開始積極進場，SpaceX與特斯拉近期走勢也愈來愈同步。
喬納斯則認為，考量成長因素，SpaceX是布局太空與情報經濟潛在商機時，估值相對低廉的標的之一。
paras_en: SpaceX (SPCX-US) stock is taking off again, but this time the market’s expectations for future volatility have shifted.

The shares surged 8% on Monday (the 5th), closing at $171, rebounding nearly 50% from their lows and returning to the IPO price, up 0.49% on Tuesday. However, implied volatility in the options is already markedly lower than in the early trading days, meaning a new high may take longer to achieve.
As the Nasdaq‑100 continues to set fresh all‑time highs, SpaceX is once again in the spotlight, pushing CEO Elon Musk’s net worth back above the $1 trillion mark.

Morgan Stanley analyst Jonas reiterated a $300 target price on Monday; last Thursday, the Falcon 9 rocket delivered four astronauts to the International Space Station in under eight hours, setting a new record.

The stock’s strength also heated up options trading. Monday’s volume hit 1.7 million contracts, double the 30‑day average, with a total value of $900 million, including 1 million call contracts worth over $640 million.

The buzz recalls SpaceX’s market action when it listed in June. Back then, the price jumped from $171 to intraday highs above $225 in less than three full trading days, with implied volatility exceeding 110%.
Now, after seven weeks of trading within a 10% price band, that metric has fallen to 55, still well below the early‑listing levels even though it rose from the sub‑50 low seen last Thursday.

Implied volatility reflects the market’s view of future price swings. This means that unless SpaceX maintains the recent two‑day rally pace, traders betting on another high will need to be prepared for a longer wait.

Based on Monday’s closing options prices, market makers estimate less than a 50% chance that SpaceX will reach $225 before July next year, while the probability of hitting $185 by the end of the month stands at 54%.

Barchart data shows SpaceX’s put implied volatility is similar to, or even higher than, calls, indicating the market is also wary of a sharp downside. By contrast, most of Nvidia’s near‑term call contracts are pricier, reflecting investors’ greater fear of missing upside.
Nevertheless, Monday’s options flow remained optimistic. Chicago Board Options Exchange LiveVol data suggests traders may have bought 456,000 call contracts versus fewer than 240,000 put contracts.

Prosper Trading Academy trader Moon said the Starship program provides a boost, Wall Street appears to have been actively buying since Q4, and SpaceX’s recent moves are increasingly mirroring Tesla’s.
Jonas added that, given growth prospects, SpaceX is one of the relatively cheap stocks to consider when positioning for potential opportunities in the space and intelligence economies.

AMD’s share price on Tuesday intraday briefly broke $658, setting a new intra‑day high, and closed up 2.8% at $649.42, establishing a new closing high.

items.title: 阿波羅主導、Pimco參貸！FT：SpaceX擬融資400億美元用來買輝達晶片
items.title_en: Apollo Leads, Pimco Joins Loan Syndicate! FT: SpaceX Plans $40 Billion Financing to Buy Nvidia Chips
paras: 外媒最新報導指出，SpaceX正尋求融資400億美元，用於購買輝達晶片，這家太空探索公司欲向銀行貸款約100億美元，並打算發行300億美元的投資級債券。
英國《金融時報》報導，相關人士表示，Apollo Global Management料將牽頭這筆交易，並協助向廣泛投資者出售SpaceX債券。
據悉，債券集團Pimco是正在就為該交易提供融資進行磋商的一小部分貸款方之一。 該交易預計將於2027年完成。
paras_en: Foreign media reports that SpaceX is seeking $40 billion in financing to purchase Nvidia chips. The space‑exploration company aims to borrow about $10 billion from banks and intends to issue $30 billion of investment‑grade bonds.
The Financial Times in the UK reported that sources say Apollo Global Management is expected to lead the transaction and help sell SpaceX bonds to a broad base of investors.
It is understood that bond firm PIMCO is one of a small group of lenders currently negotiating to provide financing for the deal, which is slated to be completed in 2027.

items.title: 財報季將至 AI晶片熱潮延續？高盛押注3檔「驚喜股」另3檔恐令人失望
items.title_en: Earnings Season Approaches: Will the AI Chip Boom Continue? Goldman Sachs Bets on Three “Surprise” Stocks While Three Others May Disappoint
paras: 近年來晶片股持續成為美股市場的重要主流板塊, 隨著第三季財報季即將展開, 高盛認為半導體產業本輪漲勢仍有望延續, 但不同企業的基本面與市場預期已出現明顯差異。
高盛分析師詹姆斯・施奈德(James Schneider)及其團隊看好應用材料(Applied Materials)、楷登電子(Cadence Design Systems)及微芯科技(Microchip Technology), 均給予「買入」評級; 相較之下, 高通(Qualcomm)、科磊(KLA)及西部資料(Western Digital)則被評為「中性」。
高盛認為, 應用材料(AMAT-US)可能在接下來的產業活動及財報中帶來正面驚喜。儘管該股今年迄今已上漲逾一倍, 大幅上漲使公司要進一步超越市場預期的難度提高, 但施奈德仍預期公司很快可能釋放更多利多訊號。
施奈德在周一發布的研究報告中指出, 高盛預期應用材料將在10月舉行的西部半導體展(SEMICON West)上調整利潤率目標, 並提出強勁的成長展望, 後續公布的財報也可望交出亮眼成績。
SEMICON West是半導體產業的重要年度活動, 今年將於10月13日至15日在舊金山舉行。根據官方資訊, 應用材料預計在11月12日公布第四財季財報。市場將關注公司對半導體設備需求、先進製程投資及未來利潤率的最新看法。
高盛另一項看好的標的是楷登電子(CDNS-US)。分析師認為, 該公司受惠於多項客製化晶片專案, 可能進一步上修全年營收展望。目前公司原先預期今年營收成長約18%, 高盛預估該數字可能被上調至約21%。
隨著人工智慧運算需求持續推動資料中心投資, 客製化晶片的重要性也逐步提高。楷登電子提供電子設計自動化(EDA)軟體及相關設計工具, 因此可望從大型科技企業與晶片設計商持續投入AI及客製化加速器的趨勢中受惠。
高盛同時看好類比晶片製造商微芯科技(MCHP-US), 預期資料中心以及航太與國防領域需求強勁, 將推動公司營運改善。高盛團隊預估, 微芯科技毛利率可能回升至約66%, 若實際表現優於市場預期, 將有助於改善投資人對公司獲利能力的看法。
不過, 高盛認為並非所有半導體企業都能在本次財報季延續漲勢。高通(QCOM-US)、科磊(KLAC-US)及西部資料(WDC-US)目前均獲得「中性」評級, 主要原因包括市場預期偏高、成長指引相對保守以及競爭壓力等因素。
高通近期股價受到提振, 原因是公司上月宣布與亞馬遜(Amazon-AMZN-US)達成晶片合作協議。這項合作強化市場對高通進軍資料中心市場的期待, 但高盛認為, 相關利多可能已推升投資人預期至偏高水準。
施奈德表示, 高盛認為短期內市場對高通的期待可能過高, 投資人目前正試圖量化高通資料中心業務最初能帶來多少營收, 同時也希望進一步確認智慧型手機市場是否有復甦可能。
高通目前正積極降低對智慧型手機市場的依賴, 並尋求透過資料中心、汽車及物聯網等領域擴大營收來源。因此, 本次財報除了傳統手機晶片業務的表現之外, 市場也將密切關注資料中心相關業務的實際進展。
科磊(KLAC-US)則面臨另一項問題。雖然全球半導體產業持續增加晶圓製造設備支出, 高盛認為科磊對未來成長的目標似乎相對保守。公司目前給出的2026及2027年營收成長指引約為25%, 市場將評估實際需求是否有機會超越這項預期。
科磊主要提供半導體製程控制與檢測設備, 因此可直接受惠於先進製程及晶圓廠資本支出增加。然而, 若公司自身指引低於市場對AI晶片及先進製程投資的期待, 股價仍可能受到壓力。
西部資料(WDC-US)則可能面臨來自競爭對手希捷科技(Seagate Technology-STX-US)的壓力。高盛指出, 希捷在熱輔助磁記錄(HAMR)技術上的推進速度較快, 這項技術能夠提高傳統機械硬碟的儲存密度及容量, 若技術商業化進度持續領先, 希捷可能進一步搶占市場份額。
HAMR是硬碟產業提升儲存容量的重要技術之一, 透過在寫入資料時利用熱能降低磁性材料的寫入難度, 讓單位面積可以儲存更多資料。隨著人工智慧及雲端運算帶動資料中心儲存需求增加, 大型資料中心業者對高容量硬碟的需求也持續增加, 使HAMR技術成為硬碟產業競爭的關鍵。
對投資人而言, 今年半導體及相關硬體股的強勁漲勢也意味著財報季的市場門檻已明顯提高。企業即使公布正面的營運數據, 若未能超越市場預期或上修全年展望, 股價仍可能因「利多不漲」而承壓。
高盛目前的選股邏輯主要集中在企業能否進一步提高獲利預期。應用材料的關鍵在於利潤率及成長展望, 楷登電子受惠於客製化晶片需求而有機會上修營收預測, 微芯科技則期待毛利率改善; 相對之下, 高通面臨預期過高的問題, 科磊的成長指引偏保守, 西部資料則需要面對希捷HAMR技術進展帶來的競爭威脅。
隨著10月財報季正式展開, 半導體企業的訂單、資本支出、AI需求、資料中心投資及2027年展望將成為市場評估股價能否延續漲勢的重要依據。高盛的最新評估顯示, 在晶片產業整體仍處於強勢週期的情況下, 投資人真正需要關注的已不只是產業是否成長, 而是企業實際表現能否超越已被推高的市場預期。
paras_en: In recent years semiconductor stocks have become a core mainstream sector of the U.S. market. With the third‑quarter earnings season about to begin, Goldman Sachs believes the current rally in the semiconductor industry can still continue, but the fundamentals and market expectations for different companies have begun to diverge sharply.

Goldman analysts James Schneider and his team are bullish on Applied Materials, Cadence Design Systems and Microchip Technology, giving each a “Buy” rating; by contrast Qualcomm, KLA and Western Digital are rated “Neutral.”

Goldman sees Applied Materials (AMAT‑US) potentially delivering a pleasant surprise in upcoming industry activity and earnings. Although the stock has already more than doubled this year, the steep rise makes it harder for the company to exceed market expectations, yet Schneider still expects the firm may soon release additional positive signals.

In a research report released on Monday, Schneider noted that Goldman expects Applied Materials to adjust its margin target at the SEMICON West show in October and to present a strong growth outlook, with the subsequent earnings report likely to be impressive.

SEMICON West is a key annual event for the semiconductor industry, scheduled for Oct. 13‑15 in San Francisco. According to official information, Applied Materials plans to release its Q4 earnings on Nov. 12. The market will watch the company’s latest views on semiconductor equipment demand, advanced‑process investment and future margins.

Another stock Goldman likes is Cadence Design Systems (CDNS‑US). Analysts believe the company, benefitting from multiple custom‑chip projects, could raise its full‑year revenue outlook. Cadence originally projected about 18% revenue growth this year; Goldman estimates that figure could be lifted to roughly 21%.

As AI compute demand continues to drive data‑center investment, the importance of custom chips is growing. Cadence provides electronic design automation (EDA) software and related tools, positioning it to benefit from the ongoing AI and custom‑accelerator spending by large tech firms and chip designers.

Goldman also favors analog‑chip maker Microchip Technology (MCHP‑US), expecting strong demand from data centers as well as aerospace and defense sectors to drive operational improvement. The team projects Microchip’s gross margin could rebound to around 66%; if actual performance exceeds market expectations, it would improve investors’ view of the company’s profitability.

However, Goldman cautions that not all semiconductor firms can sustain the rally this earnings season. Qualcomm (QCOM‑US), KLA (KLAC‑US) and Western Digital (WDC‑US) all carry “Neutral” ratings, mainly because of lofty market expectations, relatively conservative growth guidance and competitive pressures.

Qualcomm’s recent share rise was sparked by the company’s announcement last month of a chip partnership with Amazon (AMZN‑US). The deal has heightened expectations for Qualcomm’s push into the data‑center market, but Goldman believes the related upside may have already pushed investor expectations to overly high levels.

Schneider said Goldman thinks market expectations for Qualcomm may be too high in the short term, as investors try to quantify how much revenue the nascent data‑center business can initially generate while also seeking confirmation of a possible smartphone market recovery.

Qualcomm is actively reducing its reliance on the smartphone market and is looking to expand revenue through data‑center, automotive and IoT segments. Therefore, beyond the traditional handset‑chip performance, the market will closely monitor the actual progress of its data‑center business in the upcoming earnings.

KLA (KLAC‑US) faces a different issue. Although global semiconductor capital spending on wafer‑fab equipment continues to rise, Goldman feels KLA’s growth targets appear relatively modest. The company’s 2026‑2027 revenue growth guidance is about 25%, and the market will assess whether actual demand could exceed that outlook.

KLA primarily supplies semiconductor process‑control and inspection equipment, so it stands to benefit directly from advanced‑process and fab‑capex growth. However, if its guidance falls short of market expectations for AI chips and advanced‑process investment, the stock could remain under pressure.

Western Digital (WDC‑US) may face pressure from rival Seagate Technology (STX‑US). Goldman points out that Seagate is advancing its heat‑assisted magnetic recording (HAMR) technology faster, a technique that can boost storage density and capacity of traditional mechanical hard drives. If commercialisation stays ahead, Seagate could capture additional market share.

HAMR is one of the key technologies for increasing hard‑drive capacity, using heat to lower the magnetic coercivity during writes so more data can be stored per unit area. As AI and cloud computing drive higher data‑center storage needs, large‑scale data‑center operators are seeking higher‑capacity drives, making HAMR a critical competitive factor in the HDD industry.

For investors, the strong rally in semiconductor and related hardware stocks this year means the earnings‑season market bar has risen sharply. Even if companies post positive operating numbers, failing to beat expectations or raise full‑year outlooks can still weigh on the stock due to “good news that doesn’t move the price.”

Goldman’s current stock‑selection logic focuses on whether companies can further lift profit expectations. Applied Materials hinges on margin and growth outlook, Cadence benefits from custom‑chip demand that could raise revenue forecasts, and Microchip looks for margin improvement; in contrast, Qualcomm faces overly high expectations, KLA’s guidance is conservative, and Western Digital must contend with Seagate’s HAMR progress.

As the October earnings season officially kicks off, order flow, capex, AI demand, data‑center investment and 2027 outlooks for semiconductor firms will be key metrics for assessing whether stock prices can keep rising. Goldman’s latest assessment shows that, with the chip industry still in a strong cycle, investors need to focus not just on industry growth but on whether individual companies can surpass the elevated market expectations.

items.title: 看好Muse潛力 富國銀喊Meta目標價1000美元、能再漲35%
items.title_en: Optimistic about Muse's Potential, Wells Fargo Sets Meta Target Price at $1,000, Could Rise Another 35%
paras: Meta(META-US) 人工智慧助理 Muse 上線初期引發市場熱烈反應，帶動股價走高，但富國銀行認為，後續漲幅可望更大。
富國銀行分析師 Ken Gawrelski 周二(6日)將 Meta 目標價從 796 美元上調至 1,000 美元，為 FactSet 追蹤的分析師中最高。
新目標價意味著 Meta 股價較目前水準仍有約 35% 的上漲空間。不過，Gawrelski 指出，要達到這個目標，短期內必須投入更多資金。
Meta 預定本月稍晚公布第三季財報，Gawrelski 提醒投資人應「審慎以對」。他預期，訴訟費用，加上支應 Muse 產品發展而增加的基礎設施支出，將在短期內拖累 Meta 獲利。
華爾街先前一直揣測，Meta 是否會出租資料中心容量，藉此讓 AI 基礎設施創造高額利潤。不過，Gawrelski 已從 2027 年預估中刪除 500 百萬瓦（MW）的容量轉售收入，相當於約 50 億美元的潛在營收。
他指出，Muse 爆發性成長，意味著 Meta 必須將這些運算能力全數留供自用。
Gawrelski 認為，Muse 可能帶動一波由 AI 驅動的產品成長週期，最終規模可能遠超過 Meta 於 2022 年成功推出 Reels 所帶來的成長。
在富國銀行最樂觀的情境下，Muse、Reels 與核心廣告業務若持續表現強勁，Meta 股價可能升至 1,211 美元。
他預估，Meta 2027 年營業費用將達 2,100 億至 2,150 億美元，高於華爾街共識的 2,020 億美元。他預期，用於大型基礎設施等長期投資的資本支出將達 2,500 億美元，較 Meta 預估的 2026 年 1,300 億至 1,450 億美元大幅增加。
此外，Meta 今年第三季將認列 100 億美元法律費用，用於解決涉及社群平台的一般訴訟。Gawrelski 認為，這可能使當季每股盈餘降至 3.72 美元，低於華爾街共識的 6.14 美元。
Gawrelski 表示，這些獲利預估下修，可能意味著 Meta 每股盈餘將來到「本輪週期的谷底」。他預期，隨著市場開始將 2028 年及之後的 AI 產品營收貢獻納入估算，Meta 的獲利預估將持續獲得上調。
換言之，Meta 的獲利前景可望從此逐步改善。
paras_en: Meta (META-US) AI assistant Muse generated strong market reaction at launch, lifting the stock, but Wells Fargo believes the upside could be even larger.
Wells Fargo analyst Ken Gawrelski on Tuesday (the 6th) raised Meta's price target from $796 to $1,000, the highest among FactSet‑tracked analysts.
The new target implies roughly a 35% upside from current levels, though Gawrelski notes that achieving it will require more capital in the short term.

Meta is slated to release its Q3 earnings later this month, and Gawrelski cautions investors to be "prudent"; he expects litigation costs and higher infrastructure spending for Muse development to weigh on profit in the near term.

Wall Street had previously speculated that Meta might lease data‑center capacity to generate high AI‑infrastructure profits, but Gawrelski has removed $500 million of MW capacity resale revenue—about $5 billion of potential revenue—from his 2027 forecasts.
He points out that Muse's explosive growth means Meta must keep all that compute power for internal use.
Gawrelski believes Muse could spark an AI‑driven product growth cycle that ultimately dwarfs the growth Meta achieved with the 2022 launch of Reels.
In Wells Fargo's most optimistic scenario, if Muse, Reels and core advertising continue to perform strongly, Meta's share price could climb to $1,211.

He projects Meta's 2027 operating expenses at $210‑$215 billion, above the Wall Street consensus of $202 billion, and expects capital expenditures for large‑scale infrastructure and other long‑term investments to reach $250 billion, far higher than Meta's own 2026 estimate of $130‑$145 billion.

Additionally, Meta will record $10 billion of legal expenses in Q3 this year for general lawsuits involving its social platforms, which Gawrelski says could push Q3 EPS down to $3.72, below the Wall Street consensus of $6.14.

Gawrelski says these downward profit revisions may put Meta's EPS at the "trough of this cycle," but he expects profit estimates to be revised upward as the market begins to factor in AI product revenue contributions from 2028 onward.
In other words, Meta's profit outlook is expected to improve gradually from here.

items.title: AI、資料中心概念股領漲美股AMD、Marvell、Constellation同步走強
items.title_en: AI and Data‑Center Stocks Lead U.S. Markets Higher as AMD, Marvell, Constellation Rally
paras: 2026年10月07日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 美國股市週二收高，標普500指數與那斯達克指數雙雙刷新歷史收盤高點，市場焦點持續集中在AI、資料中心晶片與電力基礎設施相關個股。
道瓊工業指數上漲0.49%至51,521.04點，標普500指數上漲0.58%至7,818.95點，那斯達克指數上漲0.45%至27,599.79點。油價趨穩、美國公債殖利率回落，也降低市場對能源價格推升通膨的擔憂。
AMD(AMD-US)上漲2.8%，執行長蘇姿丰表示，公司計畫在2027年大幅增加晶片供應，以因應快速成長的AI需求，市場持續關注AMD在AI加速器與資料中心處理器市場的供應擴張。
Marvell Technology(MRVL-US)上漲5.8%，公司因資料中心晶片需求強勁，上調2028年營收預測。AI資料中心持續擴建，帶動客製化晶片、高速網路與資料傳輸相關需求升溫。
Constellation Energy(CEG-US)大漲12.3%，主要受到Alphabet(GOOGL-US)旗下Google與公司簽署3,590MW電力協議激勵，其中包括透過既有核電機組增容新增的890MW容量，反映大型科技公司正透過長期合約提前鎖定AI資料中心所需電力。
AI基礎設施投資也反映在美國貿易數據。8月資本財進口月增率4.4%，顯示企業持續增加設備與基礎設施支出。市場接下來將轉向第3季財報季，最新數據統計顯示，分析師目前預估標普500成分股7月至9月獲利年增率30.6%，其中科技業獲利預估年增率66.5%。

paras_en: October 7, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center report) – U.S. stock markets closed higher on Tuesday, with both the S&P 500 and Nasdaq hitting record closing highs. Market focus remained on AI, data‑center chips and power‑infrastructure related stocks.

The Dow Jones Industrial Average rose 0.49% to 51,521.04 points, the S&P 500 gained 0.58% to 7,818.95 points, and the Nasdaq climbed 0.45% to 27,599.79 points. Stabilising oil prices and falling U.S. Treasury yields eased concerns that energy costs would fuel inflation.

Advanced Micro Devices (AMD‑US) jumped 2.8%. CEO Lisa Su said the company plans to significantly increase chip supply in 2027 to meet rapidly growing AI demand, and the market continues to watch AMD’s expansion in AI accelerators and data‑center processors.

Marvell Technology (MRVL‑US) rose 5.8% after the firm lifted its 2028 revenue outlook on strong data‑center chip demand. Ongoing AI data‑center build‑outs are boosting demand for custom chips, high‑speed networking and data‑transfer solutions.

Constellation Energy (CEG‑US) surged 12.3% after Alphabet’s Google signed a 3,590 MW power agreement with the company, including an additional 890 MW capacity from existing nuclear units. The deal shows large tech firms locking in power for AI data‑centers through long‑term contracts.

AI‑infrastructure investment is also reflected in U.S. trade data. August capital‑goods imports rose 4.4% month‑over‑month, indicating firms are continuing to increase equipment and infrastructure spending. The market now turns to the Q3 earnings season; analysts currently estimate a 30.6% year‑over‑year earnings growth for S&P 500 constituents in July‑September, with the technology sector projected to grow 66.5% year‑over‑year.

items.title: AI投資加速企業瘦身裁員潮從科技業擴散到金融、工業與消費產業
items.title_en: AI Investment Accelerates Corporate Downsizing and Layoffs Spreading from Tech to Finance, Industry, and Consumer Sectors
paras: 2026年10月07日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 隨著企業加快導入AI與自動化，全球企業的人力調整也愈來愈明顯。這波裁員已不只發生在科技業，金融、工業、消費品等產業都陸續出現類似情況，企業一邊縮減人力、簡化組織，一邊把更多資源轉向AI、資料中心與自動化投資。
今年幾起大型案例相當受到關注。HSBC(HSBA-UK)正在評估裁減20,000人，約占員工總數10%；Amazon(AMZN-US)1月宣布裁減16,000個企業職位，重整方向與AI導入及提升效率有關；Standard Chartered(STAN-UK)則規劃在4年內裁減超過7,000人，希望透過AI簡化營運流程並改善獲利能力。
科技業的人力調整仍最明顯。Microsoft(MSFT-US)7月宣布裁減4,800人，約占員工2.1%；Cisco(CSCO-US)5月宣布裁員不到4,000人；Intuit(INTU-US)則裁減約3,000人，同時把更多資源投入AI相關業務。
這種趨勢也開始往其他產業擴散。Dow(DOW-US)1月宣布裁減4,500人，約占員工13%，並把自動化與AI列為提升效率的重要手段。British American Tobacco(BATS-UK)6月則計畫裁減5,500個職位，另將3,500個職位轉由第三方承接，希望進一步降低成本、改善利潤。
金融業同樣出現長期人力縮減計畫。日本瑞穗金融集團(8411-JP)規劃未來10年最多削減5,000個職位，DNB(DNB-NO)10月宣布裁減約400人，背後都與AI投資增加及營運自動化有關。
Meta Platforms(META-US)的情況則更能反映企業資源重新分配的方向。公司一方面縮減部分組織，10月裁減Superintelligence Labs約600人，另一方面仍持續增加AI與資料中心投資，顯示企業不是單純降低成本，而是把人力與資本從傳統業務移往AI模型、算力與新產品開發。

paras_en: October 7, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center report) – As companies speed up AI and automation adoption, workforce adjustments are becoming increasingly evident worldwide. This wave of layoffs is no longer confined to the tech sector; finance, industrial and consumer‑goods industries are also seeing similar moves, with firms trimming staff and streamlining structures while shifting more resources toward AI, data‑center and automation investments.

Several high‑profile cases this year have drawn attention. HSBC (HSBA‑UK) is evaluating a cut of 20,000 jobs, about 10% of its workforce; Amazon (AMZN‑US) announced in January a reduction of 16,000 corporate positions, tied to AI integration and efficiency gains; Standard Chartered (STAN‑UK) plans to cut more than 7,000 staff over four years to simplify operations with AI and improve profitability.

The tech sector still shows the most pronounced workforce changes. Microsoft (MSFT‑US) announced in July a layoff of 4,800 employees, roughly 2.1% of its staff; Cisco (CSCO‑US) announced in May a reduction of just under 4,000 jobs; Intuit (INTU‑US) cut about 3,000 positions while reallocating more resources to AI‑related businesses.

The trend is now spreading to other industries. Dow (DOW‑US) announced in January a cut of 4,500 workers, about 13% of its headcount, and is positioning automation and AI as key efficiency levers. British American Tobacco (BATS‑UK) plans in June to eliminate 5,500 jobs and outsource another 3,500 positions to third‑party providers, aiming to lower costs and boost margins.

Long‑term workforce reduction plans are also emerging in finance. Mizuho Financial Group (8411‑JP) is planning to eliminate up to 5,000 positions over the next ten years, and DNB (DNB‑NO) announced in October a cut of roughly 400 staff, both driven by increased AI investment and operational automation.

Meta Platforms (META‑US) illustrates the direction of corporate resource reallocation. The company is shrinking certain units, cutting about 600 people from its Superintelligence Labs in October, while simultaneously ramping up AI and data‑center spending, showing that firms are not merely cutting costs but moving labor and capital from traditional businesses to AI models, compute power and new product development.

items.title: 最快年底出貨！SK海力士旗下Solidigm增台灣ODM基地 擴大資料中心SSD供應
items.title_en: Fastest Year-End Shipment! SK Hynix's Solidigm Adds Taiwan ODM Base to Expand Data Center SSD Supply
paras: SK海力士旗下資料中心儲存子公司Solidigm9月25日發布產品變更通知(PCN)，宣布在台灣新增一家ODM製造基地，納入其資料中心SSD生產網絡，以提升製造彈性與營運持續性。
自2026年12月24日起，Solidigm客戶可能陸續收到新基地生產的產品，該公司也強調相關資料中心固態硬碟的型號、規格與品質不受影響。
韓媒《首爾經濟日報》此前報導，Solidigm已在台灣與力成科技、和碩聯合建立SSD ODM合作關係，新基地可視為既有產能的補充而非替代。在AI伺服器、高容量儲存需求持續放大下，分散生產據點有助降低單一廠區或物流中斷風險，並配合企業客戶對交期與合規的要求。
市場同時關注Solidigm資本動向。外媒先前披露，Solidigm正考慮最快2027年赴美IPO，估值最高上看1500億美元。
分析指出，Solidigm新增台灣ODM產能，可解讀為上市前鞏固供應鏈韌性、強化資料中心SSD出貨能力的布局。
法人認為，在HBM與AI帶動整體記憶體價值提升之際，Solidigm擴產與潛在IPO將進一步凸顯SK海力士在AI記憶體體系的綜合競爭力。
paras_en: Solidigm, the data center storage subsidiary of SK Hynix, issued a product change notice (PCN) on September 25 announcing the addition of a new ODM manufacturing base in Taiwan, integrating it into its data center SSD production network to improve manufacturing flexibility and operational continuity.

Starting December 24, 2026, Solidigm customers may begin receiving products manufactured at the new facility, and the company emphasizes that the models, specifications, and quality of the related data center solid-state drives will remain unchanged.

South Korean media outlet Seoul Economic Daily previously reported that Solidigm has established SSD ODM partnerships in Taiwan with Licheng Technology and Wistron, and the new base is viewed as a supplement to existing capacity rather than a replacement. With AI servers and high‑capacity storage demand continuing to grow, distributed production sites help reduce the risk of a single plant or logistics disruption and meet enterprise customers' requirements for delivery timelines and compliance.

The market is also watching Solidigm's capital moves. Foreign media have disclosed that Solidigm is considering an IPO in the United States as early as 2027, with a potential valuation of up to $150 billion.
Analysts note that the addition of Taiwan ODM capacity can be seen as a pre‑IPO strategy to strengthen supply‑chain resilience and boost data center SSD shipment capabilities.

Industry observers believe that, as HBM and AI drive overall memory value higher, Solidigm's expansion and potential IPO will further highlight SK Hynix's comprehensive competitiveness in the AI memory ecosystem.

items.title: 蘋果智慧家庭新品13日亮相 聯手LG開發門鈴、門鎖與恆溫器
items.title_en: Apple’s New Smart‑Home Products Debut on 13th, Partnering with LG to Develop Doorbells, Locks, and Thermostats
paras: 蘋果(AAPL-US) 即將擴大布局智慧家庭裝置，透過與樂金電子（LG Electronics）一項非典型合作，開發門鈴、恆溫器及其他配件。
彭博科技記者古爾曼指出，這些產品將納入蘋果的裝置生態系，搭配全新智慧家庭中樞、升級版HomePod mini及新版電視機上盒使用。蘋果這批新裝置預定於10月13日發表。
報導引述消息人士指出，與韓國LG共同開發的產品還包括智慧門鎖、室內與戶外監控攝影機，以及泛光燈攝影機。由於計畫尚未公開，這些人士要求匿名。

共同開發 掛LG品牌銷售

儘管配件由兩家公司共同開發，產品將以LG品牌銷售，並由LG負責製造及產品支援。
蘋果過去也曾採取類似策略，低調與鴻海(2317-TW) 旗下貝爾金（Belkin）、羅技（Logitech）等公司合作，開發以其他品牌銷售的產品。
這種與所謂「第二方供應商」合作的模式，讓蘋果能迅速擴大生態系，無須承擔生產及支援大量配件的全部成本與複雜流程。蘋果也能參與產品設計、調整功能及監督工程開發，同時讓多數合作內容維持保密。
LG配件的開發進度落後於蘋果自家裝置，預計至少還要幾個月才會上市。蘋果與LG發言人均不予置評。

認證文件揭露七款配件

近幾週，LG已向美國聯邦通訊委員會（FCC）及產品認證公司UL Solutions等機構申請核准。兩家機構的資料庫中，多份申請文件揭露了配件的產品名稱、規格、功能及圖面。
文件列出的產品包括LG有線視訊門鈴、泛光燈攝影機、插電式戶外攝影機、插電式室內攝影機、智慧門鎖、智慧恆溫器及溫度感測器。
LG要求將產品照片及更詳細資訊保密至明年初，文件並未提及蘋果參與開發。
多款裝置支援Wi-Fi及藍牙，也支援蘋果與競爭對手近年採用的Thread、Matter兩項智慧家庭通訊協定。智慧門鎖另具備超寬頻（UWB）功能，可在使用者接近家門時自動解鎖。

重啟HomeKit 搭配Siri AI助理

對蘋果而言，新的家庭生態系與裝置將象徵HomeKit正式重新出發。這個平台於2014年推出，但相較於亞馬遜及Alphabet旗下Google的產品，始終未能獲得廣泛採用。
蘋果希望透過智慧家庭裝置及Siri AI助理，為這項業務注入新動能。彭博先前報導，蘋果也規劃未來推出更多自家產品，包括強調隱私保護的居家監控裝置、螢幕連接機械手臂的智慧家庭中樞，以及居家安全監控服務。
對以電視及洗衣機聞名的LG而言，這批裝置也代表其智慧家庭業務進一步擴張。新產品涵蓋LG近十年來首款室內攝影機，以及近年來首款戶外攝影機、恆溫器、泛光燈攝影機與門鈴。LG也將首次在韓國以外市場銷售智慧門鎖。
這將使蘋果與LG更直接與亞馬遜(AMZN-US) Ring及Google(GOOGL-US) Nest競爭。後兩者已在智慧家庭市場站穩腳步，均提供類似裝置，讓使用者監看住宅及周邊環境的各個角落。

從螢幕到電視 雙方合作已久

蘋果與LG淵源深厚。兩家公司曾在智慧手機市場競爭，如今蘋果與LG電子旗下部分姊妹公司已是重要合作夥伴。LG Display為多款蘋果產品供應顯示面板，蘋果也曾與LG電子合作，將旗下服務整合至LG電視。
近十年前，蘋果一度退出外接電腦顯示器市場時，也曾與LG共同開發可搭配蘋果筆電使用的顯示器。
paras_en: Apple (AAPL‑US) is set to expand its smart‑home device lineup by partnering with LG Electronics in an atypical collaboration to develop doorbells, thermostats, and other accessories.

Bloomberg technology reporter Gurman noted that these products will be integrated into Apple’s device ecosystem, paired with a new smart‑home hub, an upgraded HomePod mini, and a new TV set‑top box. Apple’s new devices are scheduled to be announced on October 13.

Sources say that the products co‑developed with Korean LG also include smart door locks, indoor and outdoor surveillance cameras, and flood‑light cameras. Because the plan has not been made public, the sources requested anonymity.
Although the accessories are co‑developed by the two companies, the products will be sold under the LG brand and LG will handle manufacturing and product support.
Apple has previously used a similar strategy, quietly partnering with companies such as Belkin (under Foxconn, 2317‑TW) and Logitech to develop products sold under other brands.

This model of working with so‑called “second‑party suppliers” allows Apple to rapidly expand its ecosystem without bearing the full cost and complexity of producing and supporting large numbers of accessories. Apple can still participate in product design, tweak features, and oversee engineering development while keeping most collaboration details confidential.
LG accessory development is behind Apple’s own devices and is expected to take several more months before launch. Neither Apple nor LG spokespersons commented on the timeline.
Certification documents reveal seven accessories.

In recent weeks, LG has applied for approval from the U.S. Federal Communications Commission (FCC) and product certification company UL Solutions. Multiple application documents in the two agencies’ databases disclose the accessories’ product names, specifications, functions, and drawings.
The listed products include the LG wired video doorbell, flood‑light camera, plug‑in outdoor camera, plug‑in indoor camera, smart door lock, smart thermostat, and temperature sensor.

Multiple devices support Wi‑Fi and Bluetooth, and also support Apple’s and competitors’ recent Thread and Matter smart‑home communication protocols. The smart door lock also features ultra‑wideband (UWB) functionality, allowing it to unlock automatically when the user approaches the front door.

For Apple, the new home ecosystem and devices will symbolize a fresh start for HomeKit. The platform was launched in 2014 but has never achieved widespread adoption compared to Amazon and Alphabet’s Google products.

Apple hopes to inject new momentum into the business through smart‑home devices and the Siri AI assistant. Bloomberg previously reported that Apple also plans to launch more in‑house products in the future, including privacy‑focused home‑monitoring devices, a screen‑connected robotic arm smart‑home hub, and home‑security monitoring services.

For LG, known for TVs and washing machines, this batch of devices also represents further expansion of its smart‑home business. The new products cover LG’s first indoor camera in a decade, its first outdoor camera, thermostat, flood‑light camera, and doorbell. LG will also sell smart door locks for the first time outside Korea.

This will allow Apple and LG to compete more directly with Amazon (AMZN‑US) Ring and Google (GOOGL‑US) Nest. The latter two have already established a foothold in the smart‑home market, offering similar devices that let users monitor every corner of their homes and surroundings.

Apple and LG have a long history of collaboration. The two companies once competed in the smartphone market, but today Apple and some LG Electronics sister companies are important partners. LG Display supplies display panels for several Apple products, and Apple has also worked with LG Electronics to integrate its services into LG TVs.
A decade ago, when Apple briefly exited the external computer monitor market, it also co‑developed a monitor with LG that could be used with Apple laptops.

items.title: SpaceX股價自低點反彈50% 但這次漲勢與上市時不同
items.title_en: SpaceX Stock Bounces 50% From Low, Yet This Rally Differs From IPO Days
paras: SpaceX(SPCX-US) 股價再度起飛，但這次市場對後市波動的預期已有變化。
該股週一(5日)大漲8%，收在171美元，自低點反彈近50%，重回IPO發行價，週二0.49%。不過，選擇權隱含波動率已明顯低於上市初期，股價若想再創新高，可能需要更長時間。
隨著那斯達克100指數不斷刷新歷史新高，SpaceX再度成為市場焦點，也讓執行長馬斯克身家重新突破1兆美元。
摩根士丹利分析師喬納斯週一重申300美元目標價；上週四，獵鷹9號火箭以不到8小時將四名太空人送抵國際太空站，創下紀錄。
股價走強也帶動選擇權交易升溫。週一成交量達170萬口，為30日均量的兩倍，總價值9億美元，其中買權成交100萬口，價值超過6.4億美元。
這波熱度令人想起SpaceX於6月上市時的行情。當時股價在不到三個完整交易日內，便從171美元衝上225美元以上的盤中高點，隱含波動率超過110。
如今，經歷七週在10%價格區間內震盪後，該指標降至55，雖較上週四低於50的歷史低點回升，仍遠低於上市初期。
隱含波動率反映市場對未來股價波動幅度的預期。這意味著，除非SpaceX維持最近兩天的上漲速度，否則期待股價再創高點的交易員，可能得做好長期等待的準備。
依週一收盤的選擇權定價，造市商估算，SpaceX股價在明年7月前觸及225美元的機率不到50%；本月底前觸及185美元的機率則為54%。
Barchart數據顯示，SpaceX賣權的隱含波動率與買權相近，甚至更高，顯示市場也對大幅下跌風險有所戒備。相較之下，輝達多數到期合約的買權較貴，反映投資人更擔心錯過漲勢。
不過，週一選擇權資金流向仍偏樂觀。芝加哥選擇權交易所LiveVol數據顯示，交易員可能買進45.6萬口買權，買進賣權則不到24萬口。
普羅斯珀交易學院交易員穆恩表示，星艦計畫提供助力，華爾街似乎自第四季開始積極進場，SpaceX與特斯拉近期走勢也愈來愈同步。
喬納斯則認為，考量成長因素，SpaceX是布局太空與情報經濟潛在商機時，估值相對低廉的標的之一。
paras_en: SpaceX (SPCX-US) stock is taking off again, but this time the market’s expectations for future volatility have shifted.

The shares surged 8% on Monday (the 5th), closing at $171, rebounding nearly 50% from their lows and returning to the IPO price, up 0.49% on Tuesday. However, implied volatility in the options is already markedly lower than in the early trading days, meaning a new high may take longer to achieve.
As the Nasdaq‑100 continues to set fresh all‑time highs, SpaceX is once again in the spotlight, pushing CEO Elon Musk’s net worth back above the $1 trillion mark.

Morgan Stanley analyst Jonas reiterated a $300 target price on Monday; last Thursday, the Falcon 9 rocket delivered four astronauts to the International Space Station in under eight hours, setting a new record.

The stock’s strength also heated up options trading. Monday’s volume hit 1.7 million contracts, double the 30‑day average, with a total value of $900 million, including 1 million call contracts worth over $640 million.

The buzz recalls SpaceX’s market action when it listed in June. Back then, the price jumped from $171 to intraday highs above $225 in less than three full trading days, with implied volatility exceeding 110%.
Now, after seven weeks of trading within a 10% price band, that metric has fallen to 55, still well below the early‑listing levels even though it rose from the sub‑50 low seen last Thursday.

Implied volatility reflects the market’s view of future price swings. This means that unless SpaceX maintains the recent two‑day rally pace, traders betting on another high will need to be prepared for a longer wait.

Based on Monday’s closing options prices, market makers estimate less than a 50% chance that SpaceX will reach $225 before July next year, while the probability of hitting $185 by the end of the month stands at 54%.

Barchart data shows SpaceX’s put implied volatility is similar to, or even higher than, calls, indicating the market is also wary of a sharp downside. By contrast, most of Nvidia’s near‑term call contracts are pricier, reflecting investors’ greater fear of missing upside.
Nevertheless, Monday’s options flow remained optimistic. Chicago Board Options Exchange LiveVol data suggests traders may have bought 456,000 call contracts versus fewer than 240,000 put contracts.

Prosper Trading Academy trader Moon said the Starship program provides a boost, Wall Street appears to have been actively buying since Q4, and SpaceX’s recent moves are increasingly mirroring Tesla’s.
Jonas added that, given growth prospects, SpaceX is one of the relatively cheap stocks to consider when positioning for potential opportunities in the space and intelligence economies.

items.title: AMD再創新高！花旗看好AI代理蓬勃發展下成大贏家
items.title_en: AMD Hits New High Again! Citi Sees It as a Big Winner Amid Booming AI Agents
paras: 《Investopedia》報導，超微(Advanced Micro Devices, AMD)(AMD-US)股價持續上漲並創下歷史新高，市場對AI代理帶動的晶片需求日益樂觀。
花旗(Citi)分析師周二(6日)將AMD目標價從575美元大幅上調至華爾街最高的800美元，理由是預期AI代理將推升運算需求，進而帶動超微晶片的需求。
AMD股價周二盤中一度突破658美元，再創盤中新高，終場收漲2.8%，報每股649.42美元，改寫收盤新高。
花旗分析師指出，隨著Meta(META-US)的Muse與OpenAI的Dots等AI代理日益普及，他們目前預估CPU市場規模將從去年的250億美元，大幅擴張至2030年的3,000億美元。
分析師認為，這對AMD而言是一大利多，並告訴客戶，他們將AMD視為「CPU復興的關鍵受益者」。
AMD執行長蘇姿丰周二在台灣接受媒體採訪時表示，公司計劃在明年「大幅增加」供應能力，以因應「非常高的需求」。
華爾街分析師普遍看多AMD。在Visible Alpha追蹤的另外11名分析師中，除了1人之外，其餘分析師都建議買進AMD股票，另有1人給予中立評級。他們的平均目標價約為678美元。
隨著周二股價持續上漲，AMD今年以來股價漲幅已超過3倍。
paras_en: Investopedia reports that Advanced Micro Devices (AMD) stock continues to rise and hits an all‑time high, with the market becoming increasingly optimistic about chip demand driven by AI agents.
Citi analysts on Tuesday (the 6th) lifted AMD’s price target from $575 to a Wall Street‑high $800, citing expectations that AI agents will boost computing demand and thus drive demand for AMD chips.
AMD’s share price on Tuesday intraday briefly broke $658, setting a new intra‑day high, and closed up 2.8% at $649.42, establishing a new closing high.

Citi analysts note that as AI agents such as Meta’s Muse and OpenAI’s Dots become more widespread, they now estimate the CPU market size will expand from $25 billion last year to $300 billion by 2030.
The analysts say this is a major tailwind for AMD and tell clients they view AMD as the “key beneficiary of a CPU resurgence.”
AMD CEO Lisa Su (苏姿丰) said in a media interview in Taiwan on Tuesday that the company plans to “significantly increase” capacity next year to meet “very high demand.”

Wall Street analysts are broadly bullish on AMD. Among the 11 other analysts tracked by Visible Alpha, all but one recommend buying AMD stock, with one giving a neutral rating. Their average price target is about $678.
With Tuesday’s continued price rise, AMD’s stock has more than tripled so far this year.

items.title: 阿波羅主導、Pimco參貸！FT：SpaceX擬融資400億美元用來買輝達晶片
items.title_en: Apollo Leads, Pimco Joins Loan Syndicate! FT: SpaceX Plans $40 Billion Financing to Buy Nvidia Chips
paras: 外媒最新報導指出，SpaceX正尋求融資400億美元，用於購買輝達晶片，這家太空探索公司欲向銀行貸款約100億美元，並打算發行300億美元的投資級債券。
英國《金融時報》報導，相關人士表示，Apollo Global Management料將牽頭這筆交易，並協助向廣泛投資者出售SpaceX債券。
據悉，債券集團Pimco是正在就為該交易提供融資進行磋商的一小部分貸款方之一。 該交易預計將於2027年完成。
paras_en: Foreign media reports that SpaceX is seeking $40 billion in financing to purchase Nvidia chips. The space‑exploration company aims to borrow about $10 billion from banks and intends to issue $30 billion of investment‑grade bonds.
The Financial Times in the UK reported that sources say Apollo Global Management is expected to lead the transaction and help sell SpaceX bonds to a broad base of investors.
It is understood that bond firm PIMCO is one of a small group of lenders currently negotiating to provide financing for the deal, which is slated to be completed in 2027.

items.title: 〈紐約匯市〉美元走弱 歐元反彈、美債拋售壓力緩解
items.title_en: NY Forex: Dollar Weakens, Euro Rebounds, US Treasury Sell‑off Pressure Eases
paras: 美元周二(6日)走弱，從近18個月高點回落。隨著歐元反彈，加上美國公債遭拋售的壓力有所緩解，美元漲勢暫歇。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)下跌0.3%，報101.86點。目前仍徘徊2025年4月9日以來最高水準附近。
歐元受到歐洲公債殖利率趨於穩定帶動。法國總統大選主要候選人之一、極右派「國民聯盟」領袖雷朋(Marine Le Pen)承諾，如果當選將大幅削減政府支出。此外，歐洲央行(ECB)一名官員也發表較為正面的談話，進一步支撐歐元。
歐元兌美元上漲0.3%，至1.1259美元，擺脫近期一連串跌勢。此前法國債券市場動盪，導致歐元承受壓力。
法國10年期公債殖利率近期已升至2000年代初期以來未見水準，原因是該國面臨嚴重的財政與債務危機。法國10年期公債與德國聯邦公債之間的利差，也擴大至2012年歐元區債務危機以來的最大。
法國今年財政赤字預估將達國內生產毛額(GDP)的5.4%，公共債務占GDP比重則逼近120%。法國現任政府上周公布2027年預算案，計劃透過削減540億歐元(約607.9億美元)政府支出，將財政赤字控制在GDP的5%。
不過，法國也正面臨政治不確定性，明年4月與5月將舉行兩輪總統大選。
領先候選人、極右派領袖雷朋，以及該黨黨魁Jordan Bardella周二公布主要預算政策主張。
歐元同時受到歐洲央行首席經濟學家Philip Lane的談話提振。Lane表示，目前歐洲地區能源價格居高不下，但尚未引發歐元區經濟出現強烈的第二輪通膨效應。Lane周二接受義大利通訊社《ANSA》訪問時強調，能源價格上漲究竟會在多大程度上傳導至整體物價，目前仍存在高度不確定性。
美元暫歇 公債買盤回溫
隨著美國公債殖利率下滑，美元漲勢也暫時停歇。
10年期美國公債殖利率下跌3.5個基點，收在5.278%，30年期公債殖利率則小幅下滑，收在5.661%。兩者近期都曾升至2002年初以來的最高水準。
市場對油價推升通膨衝擊的擔憂、企業為建設AI基礎設施而大量發債的疑慮、各國央行偏向鷹派的貨幣政策，以及不斷膨脹的政府債務，都加劇了近期美國公債遭拋售的壓力。
法國的政治與財政動盪，也進一步加深市場不安。
儘管市場對聯準會(Fed)即將收緊貨幣政策的預期已經降低，美元仍維持在相對高檔。
近期公布的通膨與就業市場數據顯示，聯準會可能獲得一些喘息空間，暫時維持利率不變。
美國總統川普周二被問及美元兌歐元走強一事時表示，這是因為美國「表現良好」，並稱強勢美元「不會帶來通膨」。
